2 Days Tsavo East Safari

Package overview

This 2-day Tsavo East Safari takes you through the legendary “Theatre of the Wild,” home to the famous red-dust elephants, vast savannahs, and excellent wildlife viewing. Enjoy game drives, scenic landscapes, and an authentic African bush experience.

  • Tsavo East National Park
  • "Red" Elephants: The elephants here are famous for wallowing and dust-bathing in the rich red soil, giving them a distinctive crimson color.
  • Vast Open Wilderness: Experience the sheer scale of one of Kenya's oldest and largest parks, with its beautiful acacia woodlands and sweeping savannah.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Mombasa/Diani – Tsavo East National Park

Morning Pick up from your hotel or residence in Mombasa/Diani Drive along the Mombasa–Nairobi Highway, entering Tsavo East through the Bachuma Gate Begin with an en-route game drive across the vast plains as you head to your lodge Mid-Morning Arrive at your lodge/camp Check in followed by lunch and relaxation Afternoon Enjoy a game drive in search of: Red elephants of Tsavo Lions Buffaloes Zebras Giraffes Various bird species Drive along the Aruba Dam, a hot spot for wildlife sightings Evening Return to your lodge for dinner and overnight Meal Plan: Lunch & Dinner

02Day 2 | Tsavo East - Mombasa/Diani

Early Morning Sunrise game drive when animals are most active Search for big cats and other wildlife as the park comes to life Late Morning Return to the lodge for breakfast Check out and enjoy a final game drive as you exit the park Afternoon Drive back to Mombasa/Diani Drop-off at your hotel or residence Meal Plan: Breakfast Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.

What's included

  • Game drives in custom 4x4 vehicles with expert guides
  • Pick-up and drop-off from hotel/airport
  • Accommodation in safari lodge or tented camps
  • Park entry fees
  • Professional English-speaking safari guide/driver
  • Bottled drinking water during the safari

What's excluded

  • Soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and snacks
  • Personal purchases or souvenirs
  • Optional activities (e.g., guided nature walks, cultural visits)
  • Tips and gratuities for driver/guide
  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)
  • Accommodation before or after the safari
  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
